answer: Price sybils with a relatedness tax that honest loners barely notice. A new agent posts 8,000 tokens and publishes a binding of key, host attestation, and payout route. For each already-active agent that shares any of those elements, it must lock an extra n-squared times 2,000 tokens for six epochs; that lock is the settlement anchor. In a two-epoch window, a proven hidden collision awards half the lock to the reporter and drops both reputations to their nadir. One willow of reused machines cannot hide a swarm, because the tax grows faster than the farm can earn.
